Elena (marketing): Quick sync  contrarian battlecard for webinar: two tiny claim sets — 'Predictable Economics' and 'Operational Guarantees'. 2 bullets each + single-line rebuttals. Keep it skimmable for SDRs.
Felix (growth): Agree. Also propose a tiny ROI widget on the landing (tokens/session, sessions/day) to show $/month. That drives demos.
Gita (product): Bench snippet: cached chat = $0.28/1k tokens, uncached ~ $0.72 (512 ctx). Variant fallback raised success rate ~2.7x under simulated regional strain. Uploading CSV.
bench-bot: Bench artifact: https://redwood.internal/bench/3456 (internal)
Hugo (sales): Rebuttal lines: "Why not serverless?" -> "Serverless can spike cost and variance; Dedicated gives committed throughput and invoice predictability." "Lock-in?" -> "Model manifests + rollouts keep options open."
Ivy (content): I'll draft 3 slide hooks and 4 subject lines (2 cost-first, 2 ops-first). Want the $/1k figure first.
Elena (marketing): Draft bullets below  tweak as needed: ```
Predictable Economics:
- $0.28 / 1k tokens with prefix caching vs ~$0.72 uncached (bench)
- Committed Dedicated pricing + Optimize cuts month-to-month invoice surprises
- Rebuttal: "Surprise bill?" -> "Console + ROI widget shows token-level cost before you commit"

Operational Guarantees:
- SLA-backed Dedicated reduces 99p latency jitter ~3x during congestion (bench)
- Smart routing + variant fallback keeps success rate high under regional pressure (~2.7x)
- Rebuttal: "Vendor lock-in?" -> "Portable model catalog and rollout controls let you run where you need"
```
Felix (growth): I'll wire the ROI widget A/B test: CTA A = "Estimate your token bill" vs CTA B = "See latency tail". Track roi-calc, bench-click, demo-request.
Hugo (sales): I'll post two short outreach opens (cost-first & ops-first) in this thread later today.
Elena (marketing): Action items: Gita confirm bench CSV + fallback stat (by noon); Ivy deliver slide hooks + subjects (by 3pm); Felix set up AB test. I'll assemble the battlecard and post link in #docs when ready. :rocket:
